biggest_catch: A referred business earns a $200 reward card — the referrer still earns $100; don't mix the two amounts up.
catches: The referred person/business must register via the referral link, open a new personal or business checking account, and complete qualification requirements within the time specified.
The referrer must register for the ReferLive program and submit valid email addresses for both parties.
Maximum of five (5) reward cards ($500) per calendar year per referrer.
The referred person must not already have a First Commonwealth Bank checking account.
Reward delivery timing not disclosed on the observed snippet.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: First Commonwealth Bank's official ReferLive terms (fcbanking.com/personal/refer-a-friend/) pay the referrer a $100 Mastercard Reward Card for each qualifying personal or business referral.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns a $100 Mastercard Reward Card for each individual or business referred who registers, opens a new personal or business checking account, and completes the requirements.

c3.evidence: Mechanism: register for the ReferLive referral program and invite friends via email, text, social media, or through a local office.

c4.evidence: Timing: reward-card delivery timing not fully disclosed on the observed snippet; QA follow-up advised.

eligibility: First Commonwealth Bank customers referring individuals or businesses that do not already have a First Commonwealth Bank checking account.
notes: Use the current official $100 amount and 5-card ($500) annual cap; older official pages showed $50 with a 10-card cap and are superseded. The referred business earns $200 — that's the friend-side amount, not the referrer's.
payout_quote: The person making the referral (Referrer) will earn a $100 Mastercard® Reward Card for each individual or business referred (Referred Person or Business) to First Commonwealth Bank, who does not already have a First Commonwealth Bank checking account, registers for the offer, opens a new First Commonwealth personal or business checking account and completes the other requirements within the time specified in the offer. ... A Referrer may receive up to five (5) Reward Cards ($500 value) within a calendar year
payout_value_note: $100 Mastercard Reward Card per qualifying referral.

steps: Register for the First Commonwealth Bank ReferLive referral program.
Invite friends or businesses via email, text, social media, or in-office.
They register, open a new personal or business checking account, and complete the qualification requirements.
You earn a $100 Mastercard Reward Card per qualifying referral (up to 5 per year).
